items.context: @QuintenFrancois (205.545 seguidores), en inglés, con gráfico: «Bitcoin is trading nearly 11% below its 200-week moving average. Historically, Bitcoin has been this cheap or cheaper in just 4% of weeks.» A los ~16 min llevaba 2.867 vistas, 24 likes y solo 5 respuestas: está despegando y todavía tiene pocas respuestas. Menciona la media de 200 semanas, que se responde directo con el índice Market Temperature (99,29 → 0,67 en 364 días).
items.suggested_text:
The 4% figure is what makes this level stand out. The 200-week average spans roughly one full halving cycle, so trading below it means price sits under its own four-year average, a zone Bitcoin has only visited at the deepest points of past bear markets.

It gets more telling when you stack it with other slow gauges. A composite of MVRV, price vs. the 200-week MA, drawdown from the high and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days, from about as hot as it reads to about as cold.

What that history doesn't settle is timing. Cheap is a description of where price is, not a promise about how long it stays there.
